events.message: The file's internal index was damaged — this is what Word reports as a corrupt document — so the content was read directly from inside it.
No readable parts were found inside the file.

report.summary: This file could not be repaired. No readable parts could be found inside the file. Nothing was invented to fill the gap — if there is another copy, even an older one, that is the better starting point.
lost: no readable parts could be found inside the file
